subject: Request to hold demo slot for extended dry run & data gate
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Janelle Park <janelle@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-10T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming product walkthrough — scheduling and prep

Hi Janelle,

Thanks again for locking in time for the walkthrough. One of the asks that came up internally is to build in an extended dry run window ahead of the customer demo so Marissa (solutions) can validate prompt sets and we can exercise ingest with a subset of your traces. Given your travel note in the last thread, would you be open to holding our original slot and shifting the public-facing demo one business day later?

Proposed plan:
- Hold the current calendar slot as a private dry run (60–90 minutes) on our side so we can run sample prompts and confirm access to the sample data.
- Move the customer-facing demo to the next day at the same time so the execs have a clean experience.
- Inputs we need from you before the dry run: S3 path or secure share for sample traces, a short manifest (sample size, expected PII fields), and confirmation that we can generate representative workload traces for 1k–5k tokens.

If that works, I can put a tentative hold on both slots and Marissa will share a short access checklist. If the later demo time is impossible for your execs, tell us preferred alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — appreciate the flexibility.

—
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: ingest-access-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Janelle Park <janelle@finlytics.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-11T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming product walkthrough — scheduling and prep

Hi Logan,

Thanks — I’m on the road that week for investor meetings and will be in transit on the original demo day. Moving the public demo by one business day should be okay for our execs, but I need to confirm with Raj (CTO) — he’s out until Thursday afternoon.

We can share a sanitized sample bundle (S3 link) and a manifest, but two things to flag:
- Our security team needs a pre-demo checklist so they can approve the temporary read-only access.
- We have a compliance constraint: sample traces must be redacted of certain customer identifiers and we’ll need a quick sign-off after you validate the manifest.

I’m looping in our security lead on the thread if needed. Tentatively agree to the dry run + public demo shift; please hold both and I’ll confirm by Thursday EOD.

Best,
Janelle Park
Head of Product | FinLytics
janelle@finlytics.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Janelle Park <janelle@finlytics.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-13T11:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming product walkthrough — scheduling and prep

Hey Janelle — thanks for the quick reply and heads up on the compliance redaction requirement. I’m the SE who will run the dry run and validate prompts/workloads. To make the hold actionable, I’ve attached a concise checklist and a CSV manifest template that your team can fill out. Summary of what I’ll do during the dry run:

1) Validate sample manifest & confirm redaction fields match what the model sees.
2) Run two representative prompt sets (one short, one multi-turn) against a small ingest to ensure token behavior matches your latency window.
3) Exercise a short workload trace (200–500 reqs) to watch caching/KV behavior in our staging zone.

What I need from you (minimal):
- A read-only S3 path or secure FTP share with up to 50 example traces (sample-manifest.csv attached).
- A short list of redaction rules (which fields must be removed/masked).
- A single point of contact who can approve temporary access (name & email).

If you confirm, I’ll place a tentative 90-minute hold on the original slot for the dry run and a 45–60 minute slot for the public demo the next day. I’ll also drop a Drive folder link where we’ll upload logs and the runbook.

Attachments: ingest-access-checklist.pdf, sample-manifest.csv

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0199
From: Janelle Park <janelle@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-17T09:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming product walkthrough — scheduling and prep

Thanks both — Raj confirmed and our security lead cleared the redaction approach. We’ve prepared a sanitized S3 bucket and filled the manifest; access details are below.

S3: s3://finlytics-sandbox/redwood-demo/
Manifest: attached (sample-manifest.csv)
Access approver: Priya Anand <priya.anand@finlytics.com>

Please go ahead and convert the original calendar invite to a private dry run on May 19, 09:30–11:00 PT and the public demo on May 20, 09:30–10:15 PT. I’ll keep Priya on standby if you need immediate approvals during the dry run.

Looking forward to seeing the prompt runs — please share the runbook link when ready.

Best,
Janelle
